feedback: Written before this candidate has raced; no outcome is stated for it. The Integrator kept your iteration 4 controller unchanged (base_speed 1.7, kp 2.5, ki 0.05, kd 0.4, last_direction) so that the footprint change is the only variable against iteration 4 (404.6). Evidence for each area: the 0.09 m track gave the best s-bend result (iteration 4, progress 0.486), and 0.08 m cut it to 0.330 (iteration 5), so the track stays. The forward row at y=0.08 m fixed the oval (20 of 20 in iteration 4, against 13 of 20 at y=0.07 in iteration 3), so the row stays. Slalom progress has held at 0.16 to 0.18 across iterations 1, 3, 4 and 5 with max_error near 0.06, so turn authority and row position have been ruled out as the limit. Iteration 2 showed that widening the span to ±0.06 m raised oscillation to 0.37 and cut oval finishes, so the span stays. Depending on the next race: if line_loss_events drop below 0.95 per run and the s-bend stays near 0.49, keep sensor_size 0.016 m and test wheel_radius 0.04 m to add speed, since the slalom plateau points to speed or lag. If the s-bend falls below about 0.45, the blurred edge is costing bend response, so return sensor_size to 0.012 m and test mass 0.5 kg instead. If the slalom stays flat at 0.17 to 0.18 with either footprint, sensing is not the limit, so the next step is speed.
